text:
nina_fin: Hi team — Azure Marketplace invoice INV-AZ-2026-07 has an unexpected promotional credit applied to partner HorizonBridge (reseller_id HB-221). Credit is -$4,500 and doesn't match our promo schedule.

pat_ops: which line on the invoice? can you paste CSV?

carmen_sales: HorizonBridge says they didn't request any promo for Jul. their contract has a one-time onboarding credit for May only.

pat_ops: CSV snippet from invoice export:
```
invoice_id,sku,description,units,unit_price,total
INV-AZ-2026-07,AZ-MKT-RESELLER-09,Redwood Inference - gen tokens,3000000,0.075,225000.00
INV-AZ-2026-07,AZ-MKT-RESELLER-09,Promotional Credit,-1,0.00,-4500.00
```

nina_fin: that promo shouldn't be there. need to know if Azure applied an automated credit or if our reseller portal sent a promo flag. Opening support case with Azure.

az-billing-bot: Support ticket created: CASE-AZ-112233. ETA: 72 hours.

revops: tagging REV-5204 and saving raw invoice/export. If Azure confirms the credit, we need to decide whether to pass it to HorizonBridge or recapture (depends on contract).

carmen_sales: hold external comms until we have Azure confirmation. If we recapture we'd need legal/partner ops signoff.

pat_ops: Azure replied: credit issued due to "billing entitlement overlap" where a previous promo tag was reapplied during marketplace consolidation. They've requested our reseller entitlement mapping to validate.

nina_fin: provide them mapping and ask for corrected invoice if it's their error. don't post anything to HorizonBridge yet.

az-billing-bot: CASE-AZ-112233 updated: Azure requested entitlement manifest.

pat_ops: uploaded mapping. will update thread when Azure responds.

nina_fin: thanks. logging potential P&L impact: $4,500 revenue variance, commission exposure ~$540 at 12%. Marking for month-end review.

carmen_sales: ack. will stand by.

az-billing-bot: CASE-AZ-112233 closed: Azure confirmed it was their consolidation error and issued corrected invoice INV-AZ-2026-07-REV1 removing the credit.

nina_fin: closing this thread. will reverse temporary entries on books once REV1 is in hand.

pat_ops: attached REV1 to REV-5204. all set.
